description_en: Creates an asynchronous image tampering detection task and returns the task ID
description_zh: 用于创建异步图片篡改检测任务并返回任务ID
kebab_example: aliyun aideepsign create-image-detection-task --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF3898 --image-url https://example.com/id-card.jpg --detect-type tamper --use-tamper-small-model true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImageDetectionTask

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotency of the request. This value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. `ClientToken` supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。`ClientToken` 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be detected. Only HTTP/HTTPS protocols are supported. Specify either `ImageUrl` or `ObjectKey`. At least one must be provided
parameters.help_zh: 待检测图片的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] The detection type. All detections use the tampering detection pipeline. This parameter no longer affects the actual detection mode. The values tamper/aigc are still accepted for backward compatibility. Passing other values returns InvalidParam. Do not pass this parameter for new calls
parameters.help_zh: （已废弃） 检测类型。所有检测统一走篡改检测链路，此参数不再影响实际检测模式。仍接受 tamper/aigc（向后兼容），传入其他值返回 InvalidParam。建议不再传
parameters.name: detect_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the small model for tampering detection. This parameter takes effect only when the tampering detection pipeline is used (DetectType is not passed or is set to tamper). If not passed, the large model is used by default.

`true`: The small model is used for tampering detection. No large model report is generated. LlmResult is empty, but basic algorithm results such as AIGC/AI post-processing/PS localization are still returned.
`false`: The large model is used for tampering detection. A comprehensive large model analysis report (LlmResult) is returned.
Not passed: The large model is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
篡改检测是否使用小模型。仅在走篡改检测链路时生效（DetectType 不传或 tamper）。不传时默认使用大模型。

`true`：篡改检测使用小模型，不产出大模型报告，LlmResult 为空，但仍返回 AIGC/AI 后处理/PS 定位等基础算法结果。
`false`：篡改检测使用大模型，返回大模型综合分析报告（LlmResult）。
不传：默认使用大模型
parameters.name: use_tamper_small_model

schema.description_en: The response includes the request ID and task ID, which are used to call `GetImageDetectionTaskResult` to query results
schema.description_zh: 返回参数包括请求 ID 和任务 ID，用于调用 `GetImageDetectionTaskResult` 查询结果

Code.description_en: The business error code. `OK` is returned if the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `OK`

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. `200` is returned if the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. `success` is returned if the request was successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `success`

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TaskId.description_en: The task ID, which is used to call `GetImageDetectionTaskResult` to query results
TaskId.description_zh: 任务 ID，用于调用 `GetImageDetectionTaskResult` 查询结果
